name: Speedo silicone swim cap
description: The reliable default. Durable, comfortable, gentle on hair, and easy to pull on without the hair-yanking drama of latex.

name: FINIS team swim cap in silicone or latex
description: The smart buy for a team, a family, or anyone who loses caps constantly. Team packs in silicone or cheaper latex cover the basics without the per-cap premium.

name: Arena Powerfin Pro open-heel training fins
description: The open-heel pocket is the comfort winner for big yardage — no heel blisters, and easy on and off with cold, pruny hands. The short, stiff blade still delivers real propulsion without slowing your tempo.

name: FINIS Foam Pull Buoy
description: The no-nonsense classic done right. Solid EVA foam, a comfortable contour, and buoyancy that suits most adult swimmers — it won't waterlog or crack, and it costs almost nothing.
